name: LUCAS 2018 Topsoil: European Soil Chemistry and Physical Properties
description: LUCAS 2018 Topsoil is an extensive harmonized soil database covering the European Union, curated by the European Soil Data Centre (ESDAC) of the European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC). Based on standardized topsoil field sampling (0-20 cm depth) across 18,984 survey points in EU member states, the dataset provides laboratory-measured physical and chemical properties including soil pH, organic carbon content (SOC), carbonates, total nitrogen, extractable phosphorus and potassium, electrical conductivity, heavy metals, and bulk density.
